item.tib: tshe dbang thugs kyi bcud dril las cha lag bka' yi zur sgron
item.coloph: de ltar gzhung la mkho tshogs kha bskangs pas/ gter 'byung gi gzhung med mod kyang*/ deng 'dir slob bu 'ga' yis nan bskul ngor/ phrin las gzhan dang rigs su 'dres pa'i phyir/ cha lag bka' yi zur sgron zhes bya ba/ snyigs ma'i sgom pa tshe dbang 'od zer gyis/ gsang sems nyams len thun mtshams zhor la bris/ dge bas bdag sogs rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
